name: teradata-patterns
description: A library of Teradata SQL patterns, read one section at a time. Every statement in it was executed on a live Teradata before it shipped.
author: Uderia
license: Sections derived from teradata-labs/loom (Apache-2.0); see NOTICE.md
use_cases: Writing a Teradata statement for a task the model has no reliable form for
Diagnosing a slow query, skew, spool or stale statistics from the DBC views
Profiling a table, validating its data, finding duplicates, missing values and outliers

index.title: Attribution analysis
index.summary: Multi-touch attribution of conversions to channels: journeys via XMLAGG, first/last/linear/time-decay/U-shaped credit in SQL, and the ATTRIBUTION operator.

index.title: Customer churn analysis
index.summary: Derive a churn flag from order history (no order in the last N days), then churn rate overall, by segment and tenure, churned-vs-retained metrics, risk scores.

index.title: Customer health scoring
index.summary: A 0-100 customer health score from order recency, frequency and spend plus click-stream activity, as weighted components with tiers and actions.

index.title: Funnel analysis
index.summary: Step-by-step funnel conversion from an event table with GROUP BY flags, an ordered time-limited funnel built with MIN timestamps, drop-off and cohort splits.

index.title: nPath sequence analysis
index.summary: Find ordered event sequences per user with the NPATH table operator: SYMBOLS, PATTERN operators, MODE, and RESULT with ACCUMULATE, FIRST, LAST, COUNT.

index.title: Sessionize: group events into sessions
index.summary: Split each user's time-ordered events into sessions on an idle timeout with the SESSIONIZE table operator, or with LAG and a running SUM.

index.title: Teradata data types and casting
index.summary: CAST with FORMAT, TRYCAST, TO_NUMBER, TO_DATE and TO_CHAR for numbers, dates and timestamps; date and interval arithmetic; UNION typing; AIVector columns.

index.title: Teradata SQL basics and dialect differences
index.summary: Teradata forms of everyday SQL that differ from PostgreSQL and MySQL: QUALIFY, TOP and SAMPLE, REPLACE VIEW, volatile tables, CTAS, reserved words.

index.title: Data profiling
index.summary: Profile a table: row and duplicate counts, nulls and statistics per column (TD_ColumnSummary, TD_UnivariateStatistics), value frequencies, text patterns, CORR.

index.title: Data validation rules
index.summary: Find rows that break a rule: required fields, ranges, allowed values, REGEXP_SIMILAR formats, TRYCAST conversions, orphaned keys, duplicates, CHECK constraints.

index.title: Duplicate detection and deduplication
index.summary: Find rows that share a key, repeat in every column or differ by a typo (EDITDISTANCE, NGRAM, StringSimilarity); keep one per key, flag, delete or merge a copy.

index.title: Missing value analysis and imputation
index.summary: Count NULLs per column, find missing-value patterns by row, period and group, and fill them on a copy with mean, median, mode or LAST_VALUE IGNORE NULLS.

index.title: Outlier detection
index.summary: Flag unusual numeric values by z-score, IQR (PERCENTILE_CONT), median absolute deviation, percentile bands or a two-column distance, overall or per group.

index.title: ST_Geometry basics
index.summary: Storing points, lines and polygons in an ST_Geometry column: construction from WKT, SRIDs, sizing, the geospatial index, validity and reading geometries back.

index.title: Spatial operations
index.summary: Area, perimeter, centroids, buffers in metres, set operations, AggGeom unions, simplification, polygon splitting and MGRS references.

index.title: Spatial relationships
index.summary: Point in polygon, containment, intersection, touching and overlapping regions, DE-9IM patterns, planar versus spherical distance.

index.title: One-way ANOVA
index.summary: TD_ANOVA: do the means of a measure differ across groups? Long and wide input, what the input may contain, and reading the result.

index.title: Statistical tests
index.summary: TD_ChiSq for independence, TD_FTest for equal variances, TD_ZTest for means — input shapes and required parameters.

index.title: Teradata catalog views (DBC)
index.summary: Metadata queries on DBC.DatabasesV, TablesV, ColumnsV, IndicesV, TableSizeV, DiskSpaceV, StatsV, SessionInfoV and UserRightsV, with the columns each view has.

index.title: EXPLAIN plan analysis
index.summary: EXPLAIN and DYNAMIC EXPLAIN, reading access paths, join methods and confidence phrases, COLLECT STATISTICS to raise confidence, HASHAMP skew checks.

index.title: Primary index skew detection
index.summary: Measure how a primary index, or a candidate column list, spreads rows across AMPs with HASHAMP/HASHBUCKET/HASHROW, DBC.IndicesV and DBC.TableSizeV.

index.title: Query tuning
index.summary: Plan-changing rewrites: predicates that keep primary index and partition access, matching join key types, pre-aggregation, volatile and NoPI tables, CTEs.

index.title: Spool space analysis
index.summary: Find the requests and users that consume spool: DBC.QryLogV.SpoolUsage, current and peak spool per user in DBC.DiskSpaceV, live sessions via MonitorSession.

index.title: Statistics collection
index.summary: COLLECT STATISTICS in its accepted forms (column, multi-column, index, PARTITION, sample, summary), and DBC.StatsV queries for missing and stale statistics.

index.title: ARIMA forecasting
index.summary: TD_ARIMAESTIMATE, TD_ARIMAVALIDATE, TD_ARIMAFORECAST and TD_AUTOARIMA calls, chained through volatile ART tables, plus SARIMA and TD_DICKEY_FULLER.

index.title: Holt-Winters forecasting
index.summary: TD_HOLT_WINTERS_FORECASTER calls for additive and multiplicative seasonality, fixed smoothing factors, level/trend/season layers, and model comparison.

index.title: Moving average
index.summary: Trailing and exponential moving averages with AVG OVER and a recursive WITH, crossover signals, and the UAF functions TD_SMOOTHMA, TD_MAMEAN, TD_SIMPLEEXP.

index.title: Signal processing with UAF functions
index.summary: TD_DFFT, TD_IDFFT, TD_DFFTCONV, TD_WINDOWDFFT, TD_POWERSPEC, TD_LINESPEC, TD_CONVOLVE, TD_DTW, TD_DWT, TD_IDWT and TD_BINARYSERIESOP on a regular series.

index.title: UAF call syntax
index.summary: How to call any TD_SYSFNLIB UAF function: SERIES_SPEC, MATRIX_SPEC, ART_SPEC, GENSERIES_SPEC, FUNC_PARAMS, INTO ART and TD_EXTRACT_RESULTS.

index.title: Vector distance search
index.summary: TD_VectorDistance: nearest neighbours by cosine, Euclidean or Manhattan distance — which input is the target, what TopK limits.

index.title: Vector normalization
index.summary: TD_VectorNormalize: scale vectors to unit length or to fractions of their sum, what that changes for distance search and what it does not.
